critical_code_review_comments: fahrkontrolle_pdf.py: PDF endpoint is well-structured — mounted at /api/students/{id}/fahrkontrolle.pdf via APIRouter(prefix='/students'). Auth guard via Depends(get_current_admin). Excludes MongoDB _id in all reads. Uses ReportLab canvas API directly (fast, no platypus tables) — A4 landscape, header + matrix + routes + optional page 2 journal. Row height auto-shrinks to fit ~35 subitems + 6 category dividers on one page. Filename slug strips non-alphanumeric and joins last_name_first_name. Nice.
fahrkontrolle_pdf.py minor: journal Paragraph.wrap(avail_w, 60mm) hard-caps comment height to 60mm — very long comments could truncate. Non-blocking for realistic use.
fahrkontrolle_pdf.py minor: only orange dot indicates a comment on page 1; the actual text lives on page 2. Correct per user spec ("Ausbildungsjournal = page 2").
FahrkontrolleTab.jsx saveRating(): intentionally does NOT close the popup after upsert — comment near line 182–188 documents this. Autosave semantics match user preference A.
FahrkontrolleTab.jsx clearRating(): calls saveRating('','') then closes popup. Backend upsert semantics correctly delete the row when value AND comment are both empty (verified in iteration26 tests).
RatingPopup.jsx: uses lastPersistedComment ref to avoid redundant PUTs on blur if the comment hasn't changed. Good.
RatingPopup.jsx: savedFlash timer cleared on unmount to prevent state update on unmounted component. Good.
FahrkontrolleTab.jsx formatDateDMY(): strict regex on YYYY-MM-DD, returns '—' on invalid — safe.
